title: otostegia tomentosa subsp. steudneri
intro: Otostegia tomentosa subsp. steudneri, commonly known as Afghan Sage, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Otostegia tomentosa subsp. steudneri include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been shown to aid in wound healing and the treatment of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties.
